
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/formulahendry/p/23036505" title="发布于 2026-09-19 11:37">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">微信和 VS Code 强强联合！WeChat AHP 来了</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div class="Post-RichTextContainer">
<div class="css-1od93p9">
<div class="css-376mun">
<div class="RichText ztext Post-RichText css-u8299y">
<p data-first-child="" data-pid="ohmyLcQ4">大家好！我是韩老师。</p>
<p data-pid="VtZMQOo5">大家应该知道，差不多半年前，我发布了 WeChat ACP：</p>
<p data-pid="Fo6P2k17"><a class=" wrap external" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIwODE4Nzg2NQ==&amp;mid=2650564681&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=3e7a4626aa02f2196d3c9303a8e29c02&amp;scene=21&amp;poc_token=HKICrmqjBAV2F8RQZSO9QUk2ey1e6IcCU2a2Yazg" target="_blank" data-draft-type="text-link" data-za-detail-view-id="1043" rel="noopener nofollow">深夜发布！微信可以连上 Claude、Codex、Copilot、Qwen、Gemini、OpenCode 等各类 Agent！</a></p>
<p data-pid="cUMNV4cD">如今，已经有超过 14K 的下载量了：</p>
<p class="ztext-empty-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<div class="RichText-ConditionalImagePortal"><img src="https://picx.zhimg.com/v2-c33354a2e8ebe7b44e22612b6f56d079_1440w.jpg" width="441" height="227" class="origin_image zh-lightbox-thumb" data-caption="" data-size="normal" data-rawwidth="755" data-rawheight="389" data-original-token="v2-c33354a2e8ebe7b44e22612b6f56d079" data-original="https://picx.zhimg.com/v2-c33354a2e8ebe7b44e22612b6f56d079_r.jpg"></div>
<p class="ztext-empty-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<p data-pid="0cQ7BLU-">在之前的文章中（<a class=" wrap external" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIwODE4Nzg2NQ==&amp;mid=2650565124&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=671d68ccbfca2122fb1893f850690bbc&amp;scene=21&amp;poc_token=HMECrmqjhCwVuwaYjmxDeVkEi-0wNxiED9qwNYB6" target="_blank" data-draft-type="text-link" data-za-detail-view-id="1043" rel="noopener nofollow">六天小长假，开始！</a>），我提到了我领导的项目 Agent Rosetta: AHP x ACP - Universal Agent Host 获得了第一届 CoreAI China hackathon 的 People's Choice Award 大奖！</p>
<p data-pid="OzuCLS7z">那么，AHP 又是个什么东西？</p>
<p data-pid="X9w4ICwU">9/5 我在 PyCon 的分享中，我帮大家问了：</p>
<div class="RichText-ConditionalImagePortal"><img src="https://pic1.zhimg.com/v2-2c07f7388c31b376bfdcaa7c58332172_1440w.jpg" width="1080" class="origin_image zh-lightbox-thumb" data-caption="" data-size="normal" data-rawwidth="1080" data-rawheight="610" data-original-token="v2-2c07f7388c31b376bfdcaa7c58332172" data-original="https://pic1.zhimg.com/v2-2c07f7388c31b376bfdcaa7c58332172_r.jpg"></div>
<p data-pid="aFUNk1OI">不过，不要慌，AHP 和 ACP 是强强联合的关系：</p>
<div class="RichText-ConditionalImagePortal"><img src="https://pica.zhimg.com/v2-ba361299730c8aa1977d55dd38faf492_1440w.jpg" width="1080" class="origin_image zh-lightbox-thumb" data-caption="" data-size="normal" data-rawwidth="1080" data-rawheight="609" data-original-token="v2-ba361299730c8aa1977d55dd38faf492" data-original="https://pica.zhimg.com/v2-ba361299730c8aa1977d55dd38faf492_r.jpg"></div>
<p class="ztext-empty-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="ztext-empty-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<p data-pid="sHVHJCkR">然后，铺垫了这么多，我们就可以回到主题了：微信和 VS Code 的强强联合！</p>
<p class="ztext-empty-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<p data-pid="YKTxSOvj">今天，我很高兴和大家分享：</p>
<p data-pid="xTXP85wP">我发布了 VS Code 的 WeChat AHP extension。</p>
<p data-pid="AuqBUbRf"><a class=" wrap external" href="https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=formulahendry.wechat-ahp" target="_blank" data-draft-type="text-link" data-icon-name="zhicon_icon_24_link" data-za-detail-view-id="1043" rel="noopener nofollow">WeChat AHP - Visual Studio Marketplace</a></p>
<p data-pid="Z9RSw5G6"><a class=" external" href="https://open-vsx.org/extension/formulahendry/wechat-ahp" target="_blank" data-draft-type="text-link" data-za-detail-view-id="1043" rel="noopener nofollow"><span class="invisible">https://<span class="visible">open-vsx.org/extension/<span class="invisible">formulahendry/wechat-ahp</span></span></span></a></p>
<div class="RichText-ConditionalImagePortal"><img src="https://pic3.zhimg.com/v2-637a6e9d64679c0a67e1defa98f11abc_1440w.jpg" width="744" height="290" class="origin_image zh-lightbox-thumb" data-caption="" data-size="normal" data-rawwidth="998" data-rawheight="389" data-original-token="v2-637a6e9d64679c0a67e1defa98f11abc" data-original="https://pic3.zhimg.com/v2-637a6e9d64679c0a67e1defa98f11abc_r.jpg"></div>
<p class="ztext-empty-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<p data-pid="474ZMPPr">它可以让你的微信和 VS Code 的 Agent session 双向实时同步，在何时何地，都能通过微信远程操控你的 VS Code Agent！</p>
<p data-pid="UjNMOjK3">VS Code 的 session：</p>
<div class="RichText-ConditionalImagePortal"><img src="https://pic2.zhimg.com/v2-d30c02766889f095dde10470da7dae39_1440w.jpg" width="590" class="origin_image zh-lightbox-thumb" data-caption="" data-size="normal" data-rawwidth="590" data-rawheight="814" data-original-token="v2-d30c02766889f095dde10470da7dae39" data-original="https://pic2.zhimg.com/v2-d30c02766889f095dde10470da7dae39_r.jpg"></div>
<p class="ztext-empty-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<p data-pid="yZVWmwb7">微信的 session：</p>
<div class="RichText-ConditionalImagePortal"><img src="https://picx.zhimg.com/v2-11cf115d1e2a066818bd0ece06f22d75_1440w.jpg" width="595" height="1290" class="origin_image zh-lightbox-thumb" data-caption="" data-size="normal" data-rawwidth="1080" data-rawheight="2341" data-qrcode-action="none" data-original-token="v2-11cf115d1e2a066818bd0ece06f22d75" data-original="https://picx.zhimg.com/v2-11cf115d1e2a066818bd0ece06f22d75_r.jpg"></div>
<p class="ztext-empty-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<p data-pid="8eI_6OEY">通过 AHP，他们的 read-write 操作，都是毫秒级实时同步的！</p>
<div class="RichText-ConditionalImagePortal"><img src="https://pic2.zhimg.com/v2-55905ddf7fccaa8a05dae0554878d40f_1440w.jpg" width="462" class="origin_image zh-lightbox-thumb" data-caption="" data-size="normal" data-rawwidth="462" data-rawheight="581" data-original-token="v2-55905ddf7fccaa8a05dae0554878d40f" data-original="https://pic2.zhimg.com/v2-55905ddf7fccaa8a05dae0554878d40f_r.jpg"></div>
<p class="ztext-empty-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<p data-pid="vAjOvyNe">想一下这个场景：</p>
<p data-pid="QmtPuCMU">你先在 VS Code 启动了一个 agent session。然后累了，躺在床上，拿出手机微信，因为 session 是实时同步到微信的，你又能无缝继续肝。接下来，你又坐到电脑前，VS Code 的 agent session 是同步更新到最新的，你又可以在电脑前无缝继续肝。</p>
<p class="ztext-empty-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<p data-pid="d9wXQqEL">ACP 解决了连接任何 Agent Harness 的问题，</p>
<p data-pid="NnbuDaFI">AHP 解决了多 Client 实时同步 Agent Session 的问题。</p>
<p class="ztext-empty-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<p data-pid="bBGTk15X">其实，我们的需求，很简单：</p>
<p data-pid="27n154Q3">随时随地，用任何 Client，操控任何 Agent；再随时随地，无缝切换到其他 Client，继续操控任何 Agent。</p>
<p class="ztext-empty-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<p data-pid="rkxy0XG2">代码完全开源：</p>
<p data-pid="0P3EM4gv"><a class=" external" href="https://github.com/formulahendry/vscode-wechat-ahp" target="_blank" data-draft-type="text-link" data-za-detail-view-id="1043" rel="noopener nofollow"><span class="invisible">https://<span class="visible">github.com/formulahendr<span class="invisible">y/vscode-wechat-ahp</span></span></span></a></p>
<p data-pid="gry4s_SN">欢迎围观。</p>
<p class="ztext-empty-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<p data-pid="l_4YQxDq">也可以通过命令行一键安装：</p>
<div class="highlight">
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">code --install-extension formulahendry.wechat-ahp
</pre>
</div>
<p>　　</p>
